payload.title: A piece cannot publish without a person's approval
payload.description:
Agents write; a person decides.

```gherkin
Feature: Approval before publishing

  Scenario: An unapproved piece stays unpublished
    Given a finished piece that no editor has approved
    When anything tries to publish it
    Then it is refused
    And the piece stays unpublished

  Scenario: An approved piece publishes
    Given a finished piece
    When an editor approves it
    Then it is published
```
